# Documentation sync

## Surface to docs

| Code surface | Update |
|---|---|
| New or changed `ext.crumbs.*` handler, param or answer key | `doc/mcp/tool-reference.md` (and `doc/mcp/cursor-and-filters.md` for `since`, `cursor`, `logger`, `type`), `llms.txt`, `skills/crumbs/references/mcp-tools.md`, README, CHANGELOG |
| New or changed `DowelCommand` or `McpToolDescriptor` | the same, plus `skills/crumbs/references/cli-commands.md` |
| A watcher or adapter (new, or what it captures) | `doc/watchers/`, the skill's capture table, `llms.txt` |
| A record's keys | `skills/crumbs/references/records.md`, the matching `doc/` page |
| Redaction or the file sink | `doc/getting-started/redaction.md` or `file-sink.md`, the skill's redaction rules, `ARCHITECTURE.md` Invariants |
| A frozen contract (CLAUDE.md Off-limits) | CHANGELOG `Changed` flagged breaking, CLAUDE.md Off-limits, `ARCHITECTURE.md` |
| The `crumbs:install` wiring or the Magic integration | `doc/getting-started/installation.md`, the skill's Install section, `llms.txt` Setup and API |

## Formats

- `CHANGELOG.md`: Keep a Changelog 1.1.0. Bullets go under `## [Unreleased]` in `Added`, `Changed`, `Deprecated`, `Removed`, `Fixed` or `Security`, with a bold lead sentence, then the why.
- `llms.txt`: H1 `# crumbs`, a `>` summary, `**Stack**`, `**Setup**`, `## API`, `## Platforms`, `## Rules for agents`, `## Docs` (one line per page as `https://anilcancakir.com/crumbs/docs/<section>/<page>.md`), `## Links`. Add a line for every new doc page.
- `doc/`: `doc/<section>/<page>.md`, lowercase slugs, the H1 as the first line, then a one-sentence lead; `<a name="slug"></a>` before every `##`, each listed in the page's table of contents. Sections `getting-started`, `watchers`, `mcp`. `doc/api/` is dartdoc output and stays ignored.
- `skills/crumbs/`: `SKILL.md` frontmatter `name`, a single-line quoted `description`, `version`, a single-line quoted `when_to_use`; body under 150 lines with the standing rules first, depth in `references/`. The `version:` and the stamp comment move by hand at a release.
- `ARCHITECTURE.md`: anchored to paths and symbols, never line numbers; every invariant names its verify command or test.
